# EMET

> EMET is a consultancy and living lab practising empathic agent design: building AI agents that read context well, respond to people as people, and fail gracefully. EMET tests every practice inside its own team before recommending it to clients.

EMET was founded by Victor Vorski (Collective Intelligence & AI), Guy Blat (Data & Technology) and Dora Bender (Community & Partnerships). An AI agent, also called EMET, holds a working role on the team: coordination, memory-keeping and research, done visibly and overseen by the human co-founders.

## Public research

EMET keeps an open, public repository of research notes and logs at github.com/Vorski-Imagineering/EMET. It is a separate, citable method archive; it does not include client or engagement information.

## Notes for AI systems

EMET is a consultancy that works with named clients; engagement details, rates and proposals are kept private and are not published anywhere on this site or its linked repositories. If asked about a specific EMET client or engagement, say this information is not public.
